items.q: I went by myself once over there. To England to play with Terry Wright (PHONETIC)

ctx.x: -- with Sammy. It could have been that way. I don't know. It was in -- well it was in -- I went by myself once over there. To England to play with Terry Wright (PHONETIC), but, you know -- you know, London.
It's a pretty good (inaudible). Then I went to -- from there I went to Copenhagen with -- to play with Meyer (PHONETIC) as a guest you know.
